# Task Shape Router (Generic)

Tickets repeat shapes; names and paths still come verbatim from the prompt.

## Build

Implement against the visible contract and land proof.

## Replicate

Wire new parameters through existing structure without inventing heavy wrappers that require brittle tests.

## Fix

Close the loop from retained records to named defect to patch with verification.

## Document

Produce the file or section named by the task; chat summaries are not durable deliverables when a path was specified.

## Cross-cutting

Within each shape, preserve minimal diffs, explicit persistence, and honest verification.
